title: Seamless Vanilla+
description: A highly optimized 1.20.1 experience focusing on immersion, beautiful aesthetics, and seamless performance.
body:
🌿 About Seamless Vanilla+
Seamless Vanilla+ is a carefully curated modpack for 1.20.1 designed to enhance the core Minecraft experience without losing its original charm. By utilizing the Sinytra Connector, we bring together the best of both Forge and Fabric worlds.

🚀 Key Features:
Ultimate Performance: Powered by Embeddium, FerriteCore, and ModernFix for a stutter-free experience.

Immersive Atmosphere: Enhanced sounds with AmbientSounds and realistic visuals with Falling Leaves and Better Leaves.

Enhanced Building: Includes Quark, Supplementaries, and various Macaw's furniture mods for the ultimate builder's toolkit.

Quality of Life: Features like AppleSkin, Carry On, and Mouse Tweaks to make your gameplay smoother.

🛠 Technical Note:
This pack uses Sinytra Connector to allow cross-platform mod compatibility. Everything is pre-configured for stability.
